name: Double-bladed sword
description: The double-bladed sword was a melee weapon that had a grip in the center with two long blades emerging from either end. It was capable of dealing more damage than a regular sword, but it was less precise. It predated the use of the modern vibroblade and vibrosword. Based in part on the quarterstaff, a weapon of earlier origins, the double-bladed sword consisted of two blades set at opposite ends of an oversized hilt.
